test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_bf_text_unconstraining ( s String, arr Array(String), m Map(String, String), INDEX idx_s s TYPE tokenbf_v1(32768, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_arr arr TYPE tokenbf_v1(32768, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 1, INDEX idx_m mapKeys(m) TYPE ngrambf_v1(4, 32768, 3, 0) GRANULARITY 1 ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_bf_text_unconstraining SELECT concat('common ', 'medium' || intDiv(number, 1000), ' rare' || number), ['common', 'medium' || intDiv(number, 1000), 'rare' || number], map('K' || intDiv(number, 1000), 'V' || number) FROM numbers(8000000)
